name_input: HORIZON INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTS PRIVATE LIMITED; HORIZON INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTS PVT. LTD.; HORIZON INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTS PVT LTD; HORIZON INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTS PVT. LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for slug 'horizon-industrial-products-private-limited' (address 3/39, ROOP NAGAR) reports "Total Shipments 13 Records detected", "Latest Cargo 2025-08-19". Exact rows seen: "2025-08-19 | HORIZON INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTS PRIVATE LIMITED | BELTAN VIBRACOUSTIC TITRESIM | SHEET METAL AUTO PARTS (MADE OUT OF MILDSTEEL) SLEEVE BRACKET RZ159030269 | TUGHLAKABAD, India -> AMBARLI, TURKEY | 87089900 | BOL 8708453"; "2025-06-25 | ... | M/S BELTAN VIBRACOUSTIC TITRESIM EL | Sheet metal Auto parts (Made out of MildSteel) SLEEVE BRACKET RZ159030269 | TUGLAKABAD ICD INTKD6, India -> Ambarli, TURKEY | 87089900 | BOL 3006610"; "2025-06-05 | ... | BANGALORE ICD INWFD6, India -> ISTANBUL, TURKEY | 73269091 | BOL 2452376". Counter vs rows: page claims 13 total shipments; 5 individual rows were actually rendered (3 export rows to Turkey, 2 import rows from TR FORMAC PTE LTD, Singapore). Slug variant 'horizon-industrial-products-pvt-ltd' returned an empty record table (0 rows).
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated Indian customs export records to Turkey (Ambarli/Istanbul) on 2025-06-05, 2025-06-25 and 2025-08-19, buyer BELTAN VIBRACOUSTIC TITRESIM (Bursa, Turkey), HS 87089900 and 73269091, with B/L numbers 8708453, 3006610, 2452376. Declared HS 870899 matches the dominant observed export code (87089900); one shipment was filed under 73269091 (steel articles) — noted, not a rejection ground. The company also imports (clinch studs from TR FORMAC PTE LTD, Singapore, HS 73181900/73181500, Nov 2024 and Jun 2025), i.e. it is a manufacturer-type operator, not a pure trader. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be verified: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, importgenius.com served a JavaScript challenge, and search engines returned irrelevant results or were unavailable. Therefore domestic_status is 'unknown' with null evidence — no domestic figure is asserted or invented. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views and are left null. No rejection grounds apply: the entity is active in customs records as recently as 2025-08-19.
